messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's action to lowering their head and resting one hand on their forehead, as demonstrated in the motion reference. Transfer only the demonstrated action; do not adopt the reference person's appearance, the reference scene, or the reference camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video, including the person's identity, appearance, scene, lighting, and camera framing.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the person's action to lowering their head and resting one hand on their forehead, as demonstrated in the reference video. Transfer only the demonstrated action, not the reference person's appearance or the reference scene and camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands in the center of the frame, shifting her weight and briefly placing her hands on her hips before lowering them.","camera":"A static, low-angle medium shot from directly behind the character.","clothing":"She wears a sleeveless orange ribbed top and tight white pants with dark panels on the lower legs.","hair_color":"Platinum blonde.","hairstyle":"Short hair tied into a small top ponytail or bun.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with a slim build, seen from behind.","scene":"An outdoor, sunlit fairground or amusement park with a striped carousel on the left, a wooden building on the right, and metal crowd-control barriers lining a sandy path."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The character remains in the same fairground scene with the same clothing and hair, but the camera changed from a side profile to a static low-angle shot from directly behind. The character's action is now standing, shifting weight, and briefly placing hands on hips; no clear head-lowering or hand-on-forehead pose is visible.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's action to lowering their head and resting one hand on their forehead, while preserving the character's identity, appearance, scene, lighting, and camera framing.
uncertain: Whether the head is lowered at any point is hard to confirm from the rear view.
unexpected_changes: Camera framing changed from a side profile to a rear low-angle view.
